verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway is open-source (GitHub repo) and can be self-hosted via Docker or Kubernetes with DB-less/declarative deployment and no vendor lock-in, as documented in the repo and gateway docs. missing for 10: no explicit hands-on self-hosting walkthrough for the AI Gateway/MCP components specifically, and no independent third-party confirmation of self-hosted AI-native feature parity vs Konnect SaaS.
